RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Reserve Discipline
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description:
Measure what the gate actually draws rather than what the manual claims, and find out how close to the line a branch can safely run.
The gate needs less spare headroom above its draw before it will open, which on a tight circuit is the difference between opening today and building another generator first.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Return Drill
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description:
Practise the walk back until nobody has to think about it. Crews that have drilled the route out do it faster and argue about it less.
The emergency return window runs half again as long. It does not make the emergency less likely; it makes it less often fatal.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Second Reading
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description:
Read every record twice, by two people, and compare what they each took from it. Tedious, and it is astonishing what the first reading misses.
Every analysed record yields twice the insight.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Coordinate Atlas
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description:
Keep a real atlas rather than a folder of notes. Rooms get numbers, the numbers get used, and the branch stops relying on whoever happened to be there last time.
Returning to a coordinate finds it exactly as you left it more often. The space has not stopped moving things. You have got better at knowing when it did.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Early Warning
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description:
Collate every account of something approaching and work out what the first sign actually is. It is never the sound; it is always something about the room.
A crew that has been trained on it gets twice as long between recognising the thing and the thing reaching them.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Standing Orders
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description:
Stop placing one order at a time. Agree a standing arrangement with the parent corporation's supply service and let the branch carry more in flight than it can currently receive.
Twice as much undelivered cargo may be on its way at once.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Negotiated Terms
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description:
Find out what the catalogue price is actually made of, then argue about the parts of it that are not cost.
Everything the branch buys through the company catalogue costs a tenth less. The corporation does not mind; it would rather the branch spent the difference on something it can invoice for.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Efficient Aperture
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description:
Work out how much of the draw is the connection and how much is the branch being careless about it.
Holding a connection open costs about a seventh less power. A wider gate saves proportionally more, because the saving applies after the footprint is counted.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Rescue Training
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description:
Train for the run that goes wrong rather than the one that goes well. Who carries whom, who goes last, and what gets left behind.
The emergency return window runs twice as long. This replaces the drill rather than adding to it: the branch is not doing both, it is doing the better one.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Corroboration
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description:
Stop reading every record as though it were the first one. Set each against what the branch already holds and the work halves itself.
Analysing a record takes a quarter less work.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Alternate Exits
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description:
Map more than one way through. A branch that depends on a single remembered route is a branch that loses a crew when the route is wrong.
Fewer things are out of place when you return. Not because the space moved fewer of them, but because you were no longer relying on the one path that would have shown it.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Detection
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description:
Turn the collated accounts into something a crew can be drilled on, then drill them on it until noticing is not a decision.
Three times as long between recognising something and it reaching you. This replaces the early-warning training rather than adding to it.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Relays
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description:
Put the branch's own relays on the route the supply service uses, so a shipment is not waiting on somebody else's schedule to be noticed.
Deliveries arrive about a quarter sooner. A shipment still cannot arrive before it has left.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Leases
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description:
Stop buying and start leasing where leasing is cheaper, and make the parent corporation carry the depreciation it was going to charge you for anyway.
Everything bought through the catalogue costs a fifth less. This replaces the negotiated terms rather than adding to them.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Gate Telemetry
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description: Compare recovered route recordings with the gate's own timing records. Unlocks a persistent route-planning view of surveyed rooms and their known connections before a repeat expedition; unexplored rooms stay unknown.\n\nThe first rung. One completed route log is enough, because one survey is all a branch has when it starts.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Field Stability
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description: Read the distortion records against the gate's power trace and find what the connection was doing when the corridors stopped agreeing with the map. Lengthens how long a connection holds.\n\nNeeds the space to have misbehaved while somebody was recording it. A branch that has only ever had quiet runs has nothing to read.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Sustained Aperture
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description: Hold a wider threshold open for longer without the reserve collapsing. Lengthens a connection again, and it is the point at which what lives down there can follow a crew all the way out.\n\nRequires an entity log: the company will not authorise a wider aperture on the word of a crew that has never met anything.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Standing Connection
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description: A connection that no longer counts down. It holds for as long as the gate is powered, staffed and fed — and it ends the instant any of those stops, exactly as before.\n\nThe top of the ladder, and the most expensive thing a branch can learn. It asks for everything: routes surveyed, the space caught misbehaving more than once, and more than one thing seen and written down.
